messages:
Mia: Heads up — my PR #1427 updated the 429 troubleshooting section and some SDK snippets. CI passed but Claire reported the sample no longer reproduces the 429 sequence in the playbook. Can someone help debug? https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1427
Arjun: I can take a look. Which snippet broke? the Node SDK or curl one?
Mia: Node + Python. The Node example uses streaming + retry headers, might be masking 429 in our smoke harness.
Paulo: I think we changed the retry header example last week — moved to `Retry-After`/`X-Request-Retry`. Maybe the runner expects raw 429 sequence. Suggest adding a deterministic repro snippet with synthetic bursts.
Jen: I'll add a short synthetic load script and a unit test that asserts we hit 429 (sanely). We can run it in the docs CI job so it doesn't flake other checks.
docs-bot: Build passed for PR 1427 — https://ci.redwood/redwood/1427 :white_check_mark:
Arjun: Quick synthetic example (Node):
```js
// fire 50 quick requests to /v1/generate to simulate a client flood
for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
  fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer $TOKEN`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'test', max_tokens: 5 })
  }).catch(() => {});
}
```
Arjun: Also add a short note in the playbook: when a 429 sequence appears, prefer model fallback (lower-capacity variant) before aggressive client-side retries.
Mia: Good. Also link rot: two links in that section point to the old SDK samples page. Paulo can you update redirects or swap to the new canonical anchors?
Paulo: On it. I'll replace the hard URLs with `/docs/sdk/snippets#rate-limits` and add a 1-line migration note for anyone following the old anchors.
Jen: For rollout — can we canary this change behind a docs flag? or just merge small changes and monitor search impressions? :thinking_face:
Arjun: It's a small text + snippet tweak. Merge after CI. I'll open a follow-up to add the synthetic smoke tests and tag it `docs:needs-smoke`.
Mia: Thanks all. @docs-bot please ping #docs when the smoke test PR is created so QA can eyeball flakiness. :thumbsup:
docs-bot: Will ping #docs once a PR with label `docs:needs-smoke` is opened.
